provenance.method: deterministic cross-reference (mirrors app.js query matching); no LLM

notes: catalog_count/tag_count for taxonomy_nodes including 'engineering/energy-fusion' are noisy — issue #12 (46 discover.json items mistagged onto that node); not fixed here. recommended_actions is an array (a topic can need more than one). priority: 1=fix search now (tier-1 topic, real content, broken discovery), 2-3=search or sourcing fix, 4=retag/taxonomy-governance, 5=defer (no lever today), 6=already fine. This script does not replicate app.js's small ALIASES table (bbq/cooking/rome/ww2/plane/car/ocean synonym expansion) — tag_count/text_hits for those ~10 words are a slight underestimate of what real search actually returns; catalog_count and the concept-misroute scan are unaffected (ALIASES only expands literal text tokens).
